newsitem.title: USA: Hortense to miss Sun Puerto Rico refinery.
newsitem.headline: Hortense to miss Sun Puerto Rico refinery.

text.p: Hurricane Hortense is seen passing south of Sun Co Inc's 85,000 barrel per day refinery, ending preparations which involved cutting crude runs if a direct hit was expected, a Sun spokesman said.
"Hortense is going to be about 120 miles south of Puerto Rico," said Sun spokesman Bud Davis.

"They started reducing crude runs over the weekend, but now they're increasing them again," he said. Davis could not immediately say how voluminous run cuts were, but noted they were "not signifcant."
At 0500 EDT/0900 GMT, Hortense was 120 miles south of St Croix, U.S. Virgin Islands, packing sustained winds of 80 miles per hour (128.7 kph) and moving west-northwest at seven mph (11.27 kph).
-- Oliver Ludwig, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1620
